observations.why: Establishing a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining capability (competence).
Framing an unrehearsed rollback as one you lack asserts that genuine capability requires practiced mastery — a competence appeal grounded in security.
Restating the cadence as a structured specification reinforces the security/stability value of a maintained routine.
Naming an owner appeals to self-origination — the rehearsal program is someone's own responsibility to direct.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNotCapability
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the text asserting that a capability only exists when it has been practiced — that unexercised readiness is no readiness at all?
